sloka: अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा नदीं पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम् ।सरयूं पुण्यसलिलां ददर्श रघुनन्दनः ।। ७.११०.१ ॥
transliteration: adhyardhayojanaṁ gatvā nadīṁ paścānmukhāśritām ।sarayūṁ puṇyasalilāṁ dadarśa raghunandanaḥ ।। 7.110.1 ॥

translations.english: Having traveled one and a half yojanas, Rama saw the sacred-watered Sarayu river, which flowed westward.
